concerns.text: FR-008 states that the PyBullet filter’s scoring mechanism must be validated against an independent physics engine (MuJoCo) to avoid circularity, yet the downstream evaluation (FR-005, SC-002) uses MuJoCo‑validated physics‑consistency scores as the primary performance metric. Using the same engine for both validation of the filter and as the ultimate outcome measure creates a circular validation loop: the filter is judged good because it predicts MuJoCo scores, and model performance is judged good because it is evaluated with MuJoCo scores. This undermines the claim that the filter provides independent evidence of physical consistency and makes the equivalence test potentially tautological.
